name: Gafadurahuette - Gaflei
description_md:
The Gafadurahuette to Gaflei route is a waymarked hiking route in LI. This path is signposted as 30 and covers a distance of 10.4 km.

The trail involves 901 m of ascent and 842 m of descent. It is part of a local waymarked hiking network and is classified as easy. The walking time is about 6.0 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The route passes Landtag within 1700 m, Vaduz within 1700 m, and Rotes Haus within 1800 m.
